Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Karan Singh Yadav
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Samit Gopal,J.
1.
List revised.
2. Heard Sri Karan Singh Yadav, learned counsel for the applicant, Sri Ajay Singh, learned A.G.A.-I for the State and perused the material on record.

3. The present anticipatory bail application under Section 438 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the applicant Smt. Amana Begum, seeking anticipatory bail, in the event of arrest in Case Crime No.14 of 2003, u/s 363, 366, 376, 506 IPC and 7 Crl. Law Amendment Act, Police Station Mahila Thana,
District Jhansi.
4. Learned counsel for the State submits that he has received instructions in the matter for which he had sought time on 17.10.2023.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant submits that applicant has been falsely implicated in the present case.
The applicant is a lady.
It is further submitted that charge sheet with regards to the applicant was submitted separately.

In so far as main accused Mehboob Kha is concerned, he has been acquitted of the charges levelled against him vide judgement and order dated 15.11.2003 passed by Addl. Sessions Judge/F.T.C. Court No.2, Jhansi in S.T. No.180 of 2003, State Vs.
Mehboob Kha, copy of the same is annexed as annexure no.3 to the affidavit filed in support of anticipatory bail application.

entities.text: Addl. Sessions Judge/F.T.C. Court No.2, Jhansi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The applicant was granted interim anticipatory bail vide order dated 17.10.2023 by a co-ordinate Bench of this Court.
The applicant has no criminal history, para 20 of the affidavit has been placed before the Court.
6. Learned counsel for the State opposed the prayer for anticipatory bail.

7. After having heard learned counsel for the parties and perusing the records, it is evident that the applicant was granted interim anticipatory bail vide order dated 17.10.2023 by a coordinate Bench of this Court, the said order reads as under:-
"1. Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the material available on record.
2.

Apprehending his arrest, the present anticipatory bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant - Smt. Amana Behum in Case Crime No.14 of 2003, under Sections 363, 366, 376, 506 I.P.C. and 7 Criminal Law Amendment Act, Police Station Mahila Thana, District Jhansi, with a prayer to enlarge her on anticipatory bail.
3. Learned A.G.A. states that he has not received instructions so far in this matter.
4. As per F.I.R. version, accused Mahboob Khan kidnapped the daughter of the informant with the help of his mother, the present applicant and father.
F.I.R. was lodged on 9.3.2003 and after investigation, charge-sheet was submitted into the matter.
5. It is submitted by the learned counsel for the applicant that the applicant is innocent and has no concern with the present matter.
She has been falsely implicated in this matter.
She has not committed any offence.
Allegations levelled against the applicant are false.
Applicant's case is squarely covered under Section 438 Cr.P.C.
It is further submitted that in this matter the main accused Mahboob Khan has been acquitted by the trial court.
It is further submitted that she is having no criminal history to her credit.
It is further submitted that no custodial interrogation is required in this matter from the applicant.
It is further submitted that if the applicant is enlarged on bail, she will not misuse the liberty.
The applicant has apprehension of her arrest in this matter.

sentences.text: Learned A.G.A. opposed the prayer for anticipatory bail and requested for some time to enable him to obtain instructions in the matter.
7. Time is granted.
Let instructions be obtained by the learned A.G.A. within two weeks.
8. As an interim measure, till the next date of listing, the applicant is granted interim anticipatory bail in the aforesaid case crime number.

(iii) The applicant shall not leave India without the previous permission of the Court and if she has passport, the same shall be deposited by her before the S.S.P./S.P.
Concerned.
9.
In case of default of any of the conditions, same may be a ground for cancellation of interim protection granted to the applicant.

10. List this case on 28.11.2023 before the appropriate Bench.".
8.
The applicant is a lady.
Co-accused Mehboob Kha has been acquitted by the concerned trial court of the charges levelled against him under Sections 363, 366, 376, 506 IPC and 7 Crl. Law Amendment Act.

The order dated 17.10.2023 is hereby made absolute till conclusion of trial on furnishing a fresh personal bond of Rs. 50,000/- with two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:-
(i) the applicant shall make herself available on each and every date fixed in the matter by the court concerned.

(ii) the applicant shall not directly or indirectly, make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court.
(iii) the applicant shall not leave India without the previous permission of the Court and if she has a passport, the same shall be deposited by her before the concerned court.
